channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula tem 58% e Flávio, 30%, no 2º turno na PB, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading voting intentions in Paraíba for the 2026 presidential elections, with 53% in the first round and 58% in the second. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) ranks second, with 24% in the first round and 30% in the second. Other candidates collectively received less than 5% support.

item.title: O presente que Flávio Bolsonaro não conseguiu entregar a Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to present a Brazilian national team jersey to Donald Trump during a White House meeting but was blocked by Secret Service security protocols. The meeting, held in the Oval Office, focused on the potential designation of Brazil's PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the U.S., as well as Trump's inquiry into Jair Bolsonaro's health and house arrest. Flávio sought to bolster his 2026 presidential candidacy amid controversy over Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master.

item.title: ONS terá operação especial para evitar apagões em jogos da Copa
item.description: The National Electric System Operator (ONS) has launched a special operation in the National Interconnected System (SIN) to prevent power outages during Brazil's matches in the 2026 World Cup, banning interventions that could cause load shedding nationwide except for urgent maintenance, from two hours before to two hours after each game on June 11, 13, 19, and 24. Continuous weather monitoring is also in place to anticipate storms and atmospheric discharges, with measures extendable if Brazil advances in the tournament.

item.title: PL vê palanque de Flávio Bolsonaro ruir no Rio após operações contra Cláudio Castro
item.description: Federal Police investigations into former Rio governor Cláudio Castro (PL) over the Banco Master and Rioprevidência funds are weakening the Bolsonaro-aligned political base in the state, prompting the PL to consider Senate alternatives like Sóstenes Cavalcante and Carlos Jordy. The scandal also threatens Douglas Ruas’ gubernatorial bid, as his 'continuity' narrative with Castro is being exploited by opponents, especially Eduardo Paes’ allies.

item.title: Justiça eleitoral oficializa expulsão de Aldo Rebelo do Democracia Cristã
item.description: The Electoral Justice officially expelled Aldo Rebelo from the Christian Democracy party after the national leadership replaced him as presidential pre-candidate with Joaquim Barbosa. Rebelo challenged the expulsion in court, arguing it violated the party’s statute and vowed to maintain his candidacy until the party convention, even if requiring judicial intervention. The internal conflict escalated after Rebelo criticized the leadership for allegedly being concerned about the Master case in Alagoas, involving the party president’s son.

item.title: Oposição tentará constranger governo e Centrão em votação da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition, led by the PL, plans to use a preference highlight in the vote on the PEC to end the 6×1 work schedule to force the government and the Centrão to vote against a more radical proposal — a 36-hour weekly workweek (4×3) advocated by Deputy Erika Hilton. The goal is to expose inconsistencies in the allied base, which claims to support reduced working hours but may be pressured to reject a greater advancement, damaging their image with voters.

item.title: O silêncio de Trump sobre encontro com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Donald Trump did not publicly comment on his meeting with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro at the White House, despite his usual practice of sharing such encounters on Truth Social. Flávio posted photos from the meeting and said he urged Trump to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, while the White House issued no official statement. The meeting, which was not on Trump’s official schedule, was allegedly arranged by Eduardo Bolsonaro, amid controversy over an audio in which Flávio sought funding from a banker for a film about his father.

item.title: Márcio Coimbra na Crusoé: A audiência de cortesia de Flávio na Casa Branca
item.description: Márcio Coimbra, a specialist in Brazilian right-wing foreign policy, comments on Flávio Bolsonaro's courtesy visit to the White House, emphasizing his experience in building U.S. relations, including the first contact with Marco Rubio in 2018. He views the meeting as a strategic move in the Bolsonaro family's international agenda. The article was originally published in O Antagonista.

item.title: PT abre canal para colher propostas ao plano de governo de Lula
item.description: The PT will launch this Friday a digital channel to collect societal proposals that may be included in Lula’s government plan for his 2026 re-election bid. The submission period will remain open until June 30, with final reports presented by July 15, supported by the Perseu Abramo Foundation. The launch event will feature PT national president Edinho Silva and government program coordinator Sergio Gabrielli, emphasizing the importance of societal participation in shaping the platform.

item.title: O Glossário Eleitoral explica o papel do observador eleitoral
item.description: The role of the electoral observer has evolved in Brazil: originally tied to monitoring party conventions by the Electoral Justice, this function was abolished after the 1988 Federal Constitution granted parties autonomy. Today, the term primarily refers to international actors who monitor elections abroad to ensure transparency, legality, and credibility of results.

item.title: Flávio tenta derrubar post que o liga a ‘rachadinha’, mas juiz rejeita
item.description: Judge Hilmar Castelo Branco Raposo Filho of the TJ-DFT denied Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s request for an injunction to remove a social media video linking him to 'rachadinha', money laundering, and militia ties, which he claims is taken out of context. Although the urgent relief was denied, the merits of the case remain under analysis, with the judge emphasizing the need for contradiction and evidence before restricting public debate. The ruling aims to prevent the judiciary from becoming a tool for censoring political speech.

item.title: Sergio Lirio: ‘Flávio se portou como serviçal de Trump’
item.description: Sergio Lirio, editor-in-chief of CartaCapital, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro’s brief visit to the White House, stating the pre-candidate behaved like a 'servant' of Donald Trump in the photo taken together. Lirio argued the image reveals a subordinate relationship between the Bolsonaro clan and the Republican, intended to distract from Flávio’s alleged intimate ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro, exposed by The Intercept’s audio leaks. Flávio also said he asked Trump to label the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist groups, which could justify U.S. military intervention in Brazil.

item.title: Ao vivo: Comissão da 6 X 1 vota o relatório de Leo Prates
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies is voting on a report by Deputy Leo Prates (Republicanos-BA) proposing the abolition of the 6x1 work schedule, gradually reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary reduction, effective 60 days after the constitutional amendment is promulgated. The proposal guarantees two weekly rest days, preferably one on Sundays, allows collective bargaining in continuous-operation sectors like health and public security, and excludes workers with higher education degrees and salaries above 2.5 times the INSS ceiling (R$ 21,188).

item.title: Condomínios em cidade do ES ameaçam multar moradores por bandeira do Brasil em varandas durante Copa e eleições
item.description: Condominiums in Serra and Vila Velha, Espírito Santo, are banning the display of the Brazilian flag on balconies and facades, citing internal regulations, sparking backlash from residents who view the move as a restriction on patriotism ahead of the 2026 World Cup and 2026 elections. Legal experts state that blanket bans on the national flag may be illegal under Federal Law No. 5.700/1971, which permits patriotic displays on private property, although neutral aesthetic rules applied equally may be permissible.

item.title: 'Senadora do Bolsonaro', Soraya Thronicke declara apoio a Lula: 'Me deixou de queixo caído'
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) declared her support for the re-election of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), stating that his humanity left her 'jaw-dropped'. Elected in 2018 as 'Bolsonaro's senator', she defended having no fear of changing sides and said the country needs more time to be rebuilt, advocating for Lula's re-election in the first round.

item.title: O bombeiro de Flávio Bolsonaro contra efeitos da crise do ‘Dark Horse’ na Faria Lima
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, has been acting as a 'firefighter' in financial markets to mitigate the fallout from a controversial multimillion-dollar deal with Daniel Vorcaro over the production of 'Dark Horse'. The crisis, centered in Faria Lima, threatens to damage the candidate's image among investors. Marinho's efforts aim to contain the damage and restore confidence in Bolsonaro's political project.

item.title: Crusoé: Enquanto Flávio se reúne com Trump, Amorim vai a…
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, while Celso Amorim, Lula’s special advisor for international affairs, traveled to Russia to meet with Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov. The parallel trips highlight a divide in Brazil’s foreign policy between the Lula government and Trump-aligned opposition figures.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia R$ 2,8 bi da Petrobras no AM
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced on Wednesday, May 27, 2026, investments of R$ 2.8 billion by Petrobras and Transpetro in Amazonas through 2030, including well drilling in the Urucu pole and the construction of 18 barges for fuel transport. The event took place at the Bertolini Shipyard in Manaus and was attended by Petrobras President Magda Chambriard, Transpetro President Sérgio Bacci, and Transport Minister George Santoro.

item.title: Mendonça vota para anular processo no qual deputado do PL é réu
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça voted to annul the legal process against federal deputy Filipe Barros (PL-PR), who is accused of defamation and insult toward prosecutor Suzana Broglia Feitosa de Lacerda, arguing that Barros’ statements were made in the exercise of his parliamentary duties and thus protected by legislative immunity. Mendonça’s vote aims to nullify all acts of the state court, citing a causal link between the deputy’s remarks and his public office. The virtual plenary judgment is set to continue until next Friday.

item.title: Lula fala sobre gostar do Brasil 1 dia após encontro Flávio-Trump
item.description: Lula posted a social media video emphasizing the importance of Brazilians loving their country and its natural resources, without directly mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Trump. The video came one day after the senator met with former U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, discussing public security, trade tariffs, and requesting the designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. The meeting drew criticism from Lula's allies, who accused Flávio of diverting attention from investigations into his ties with Daniel Vorcaro, while opposition figures praised the engagement as a sign of international prestige.

item.title: Lula tem quase 30 pontos de vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro na Paraíba, mostra pesquisa
item.description: Lula holds a nearly 30-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in Paraíba, with 53% in the first round and 58% in the second round, compared to Bolsonaro’s 24% and 30%, respectively. The president also leads in government approval at 56%, while other candidates trail significantly. The survey of 1,600 voters conducted May 25–26 has a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: Petrobras se manifesta sobre possível interesse em refinaria da Refit
item.description: Petrobras denied having made any relevant decision regarding a possible acquisition of the Refit refinery, stating it continuously evaluates business opportunities aligned with its corporate strategy, including in refining. The statement followed an O Globo report suggesting the company’s interest in taking over the Refit site to expand refining operations, involving talks between the Rio governor and Petrobras’ president. The Manguinhos refinery is considered a 'crown jewel' by the Lula government.

item.title: Juiz oficializa expulsão de Aldo Rebelo do Democracia Cristã
item.description: Electoral judge Tiago Machado formalized the expulsion of Aldo Rebelo from the Christian Democracy (DC) party on Monday, May 25, 2026, confirming a decision by the party’s national leadership. The move reflects an internal power struggle over the party’s presidential nomination, as DC now backs former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa as its pre-candidate, while Rebelo maintains his candidacy and plans to appeal. The TSE has already recorded Rebelo’s removal from party rolls, and Barbosa has conditioned his potential candidacy on the party having adequate organizational structure, having retired from the STF in 2014.

item.title: Fontes do Itamaraty rebatem acusações de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre embaixada nos EUA
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro accused the Brazilian Embassy in Washington of denying an informal request to use its facilities for a press meeting after a meeting with Donald Trump. The Itamaraty countered that the request was made informally and at the last minute, without following official protocols for diplomatic space usage, and noted that the opposition had previously used the embassy but only through formal, pre-arranged official missions.

item.title: Brasil Adiante: Estadão discute propostas concretas e viáveis para os problemas brasileiros
item.description: The 'Brasil Adiante' project by Estadão brings together experts and civil society leaders to discuss practical and viable solutions to Brazil's main challenges, including health, education, public security, and institutions. The first meeting, curated by Fábio Barbosa, takes place this Wednesday (27) and features two panels: one on the role of the state in the desired Brazil, and another on judicial reform to restore public trust in the Judiciary.

item.title: Caso envolvendo senador e voo pago em dinheiro vivo chega ao STF
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB-PB) for allegedly using an undeclared aircraft during his electoral campaign, with payments made primarily in cash and minimal banking traceability. The pilot confirmed the flights, and the PF states there is evidence indicating an aerial transportation service benefiting the campaign was not reported in financial disclosures. The case, initially handled by the Paraíba Electoral Court, was transferred to the Supreme Federal Court due to the senator’s privileged forum.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro busca foto com Trump para tirar foco da crise do Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is seeking a photo with Donald Trump to divert attention from a crisis involving his alleged financial ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, which is under investigation by the Federal Police for possible money laundering and passive corruption. The strategy aims to project political strength and international influence, but the crisis persists due to unanswered questions about the origin, destination, and participants of the alleged funds.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ironiza reação de Jair Bolsonaro à CPI da Covid em documentário
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is featured prominently in the documentary 'Anatomia do Caos', defending the federal government's handling of the pandemic under his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The film, premiering on July 2, uses the Covid CPI investigations as a narrative thread to revisit decisions, omissions, and political disputes during the health crisis, while also raising questions about memory and accountability in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro exibe moeda de honra que ganhou de Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he received a 'challenge coin' from Donald Trump during a White House meeting on May 26, 2026, calling it a rare gesture reserved for allies and a sign of great prestige. The coin is a traditional U.S. military token symbolizing recognition, belonging, or remembrance of an official visit. Flávio added that Trump inquired about the imprisonment conditions of former president Jair Bolsonaro, a detail critics labeled a 'smokescreen' to divert attention from other issues.

item.title: Acordo de Flávio com partidos do Centrão trava após crise por mensagens com Vorcaro, e chapa com vice do PL ganha força
item.description: The scandal involving messages exchanged between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master led to the withdrawal of support from the Centrão parties (União-PP) for his presidential ticket. The expectation that the União-PP federation would nominate his running mate was abandoned due to fears of further revelations and political damage, especially after PP leader Ciro Nogueira became a target of a PF investigation tied to the same case. As a result, a pure PL ticket—with Flávio as presidential candidate and a vice from his own party—has gained strength as the most viable option.

item.title: O dia D da PEC do fim da escala 6×1 na Câmara
item.description: The PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, a priority of the Lula government, is expected to be approved in the Chamber’s special committee this Wednesday, with a possible plenary vote today or Thursday. Chamber President Hugo Motta aims to expedite the process to allow Senate review before the parliamentary recess, despite anticipated opposition resistance and tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The measure enjoys broad popular support and is backed by Lula’s coalition and the Centrão.

item.title: Visitada por Lula, BR-319 tem trechos sem asfalto após 50 anos de disputas
item.description: President Lula visited the BR-319 in May 2026 to oversee works on the Charlie stretch, emphasizing a commitment to the world's highest environmental care. The 885-km highway, inaugurated in 1972, still has long unpaved sections, especially in the 'middle stretch' (km 250-655), where environmental resistance and rainy-season mud hinder traffic. Paving is a government priority, but requires inter-ministerial agreements to prevent deforestation and illegal occupation.

item.title: Passado o choque, empresariado volta a ter Flávio Bolsonaro como candidato preferencial
item.description: Despite the shocking revelation of Flávio Bolsonaro’s brotherly relationship with Daniel Vorcaro and the senator’s attempts to downplay it with falsehoods, Brazilian business leaders have largely returned to supporting him as their preferred candidate, maintaining their prior stance—some more reluctantly than others.

item.title: Primeiro encontro do ‘Brasil Adiante’ discute reforma do Judiciário e fundamentos do crescimento
item.description: The first meeting of Estadão's 'Brasil Adiante' project discusses Judicial reform and economic growth foundations, focusing on institutional stability and an executable agenda for the first two years of the next government. The event marks the start of Estadão's 2026 electoral coverage, featuring live transmission and experts such as Marcos Mendes, Jéssika Moreira, and Pedro Parente. Proposals will be consolidated into a document to be delivered to the presidential election winner in November.

item.title: Encontro com Trump é trunfo para Flávio Bolsonaro e acende alerta sobre papel da Casa Branca na eleição
item.description: Experts consulted by the BBC say that Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Donald Trump has limited impact on voters and does not alleviate the senator's political wear, though they warn of potential U.S. interference in Brazil's 2026 elections.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro foi à Casa Branca. E só.
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated his meeting in the Oval Office with the U.S. president as a milestone in his political career, calling it one of his greatest achievements. He emphasized the symbolic importance of the location, described as the 'most powerful square meter in the world'.

item.title: Nos EUA, Flávio pede a eleitores que engajem nas redes sociais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, urged supporters in the U.S. to engage on social media in a 'daily battle' against the PT following a meeting with Donald Trump. He praised his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro for continuing to fight for Brazil's freedom from abroad and emphasized policies including public safety, tax reduction, employment, and flexible work hours, inspired by Jair Bolsonaro's government. Flávio warned that a PT victory would be 'disastrous' and cause irreparable damage, but expressed faith in God and the effort to rescue Brazil.

item.title: Grupos ligados ao PT intensificam campanha nas redes para pressionar parlamentares por fim da escala 6x1
item.description: PT-aligned groups intensified social media campaigns to pressure lawmakers into approving the 6x1 workweek PEC, which would reduce the maximum weekly work hours from 44 to 40 over one year, guaranteeing two days off per week without pay cuts. The proposal is set for vote in the Chamber this week, following an agreement between Lula and Chamber President Hugo Motta. The measure is seen as a priority for the Lula administration and a potential campaign issue for his 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: Foto com Trump não livra Flávio do Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to Washington to overcome a crisis in his 2026 pre-campaign triggered by revelations of alleged 'brother' ties with businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Although he secured a formal photo with Donald Trump, the gesture failed to mitigate the damage to his image amid a scandal involving allegations of a multimillion-dollar production about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The exclusive subscriber article concludes that the Trump photo did not reverse the negative narrative.

item.title: Cláudio Castro e o dinheiro dos aposentados no Banco Master - O Assunto #1728
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro is targeted in the eighth phase of Operation Compliance Zero for allegedly facilitating a R$ 3.7 billion investment from the Rioprevidência pension fund into troubled assets at Banco Master, linked to Daniel Vorcaro. Investigators cite a close personal relationship between Castro and Vorcaro as key to the scheme, and report that Flávio Bolsonaro contacted Vorcaro even after the PL-RJ leadership knew of the impropriety. Castro’s Senate candidacy is now seen as politically dead by the PL leadership.

item.title: Impacto das apostas no orçamento doméstico é limitado
item.description: The impact of betting on household budgets is limited, according to recent analysis, despite concerns raised by President Lula about family indebtedness. While the regulated sector operates under restrictions — such as the ban on credit card use — the illicit market continues to exploit abusive practices without oversight. The debate must be grounded in evidence to avoid ineffective or exaggerated solutions.

item.title: Camisa da seleção retida, entrada rápida de Eduardo e recado de Bolsonaro: os bastidores do encontro entre Flávio e Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with Donald Trump at the White House following coordination involving Eduardo Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo, with the meeting initially uncertain due to international negotiations over Iran. Flávio brought a Brazilian national team jersey to gift Trump, but it was retained by White House security for inspection. During the approximately 1h40 meeting, Trump inquired about Jair Bolsonaro's situation, and Flávio conveyed an embrace from the former president, receiving a symbolic 'challenge coin' in return.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: comissão da Câmara vota proposta hoje; entenda o que está em jogo
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies is voting today on a PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours and guaranteeing two days off per week, one preferably on Sundays. The change will be implemented in two phases: an immediate two-hour reduction 60 days after promulgation, followed by another two-hour reduction within 12 months, with salaries maintained. Workers earning above R$ 21,100 are exempt from the working hour limits.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vê Flávio tentando ‘mudar de assunto’ após encontro com Trump e manterá ataques sobre elo com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula's pre-campaign team views Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Donald Trump as an attempt to 'change the subject' amid fallout from his messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The PT strategy is to ignore the meeting and maintain focus on Flávio's ties to Vorcaro, viewing the encounter as a symbolic, unsubstantiated effort to bolster his image among Bolsonarist supporters.

item.title: Encontro de Flávio e Trump vira meme nas redes sociais
item.description: A meeting between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House became a viral meme on social media, featuring AI-generated images depicting the senator in subservient roles. The meeting, arranged by Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, lasted between 1 hour and 1 hour 40 minutes, according to reports, and ended with document delivery and a photo in the Oval Office. Neither Bolsonaro brother confirmed the exact duration of the encounter.

item.title: Governistas chamam encontro de Flávio e Trump de cortina de fumaça
item.description: PT government allies criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, calling it a 'smokescreen' to divert attention from controversies linking him to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Officials including Guilherme Boulos, Lindbergh Farias, and José Dirceu accused the senator of seeking a photo op with Trump to avoid scrutiny over an alleged scheme to divert R$4 billion from RioPrevidência via the Master Group. Boulos mocked the Bolsonaro family's subservience to the U.S., while Dirceu claimed the trip aimed to 'conspire against Brazil'.

item.title: Caiado é o pré-candidato com melhor “condição moral”, diz Leite
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) of Rio Grande do Sul stated that Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is the presidential pre-candidate with the best 'moral condition' to lead Brazil, praising his management capacity, political articulation, and emotional intelligence. Leite criticized other candidates, specifically mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for having ties he considers tainted with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, and said Caiado is the only one who possesses the necessary qualities to govern in a complex country like Brazil, despite acknowledging personal disagreements with the pre-candidate.

item.title: Bolsonaristas elogiam encontro entre Flávio e Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026. The meeting drew praise from Bolsonaro supporters, who highlighted discussions on public security, organized crime, and the legal situation of Jair Bolsonaro. PL lawmakers welcomed the encounter as a significant step in Flávio’s potential presidential campaign.

item.title: Congresso da Bolívia abre caminho para que presidente possa conter protestos com militares
item.description: Bolivia's Congress approved the removal of a 2020 norm that limited the president's ability to declare states of exception, now allowing Rodrigo Paz to deploy the military to contain protests demanding his resignation. The measure passed the Chamber of Deputies with over two-thirds support, following prior Senate approval, clearing the legal path for exceptional executive authority amid escalating unrest.

item.title: Decreto de Lula sobre redes com atribuições para agência fiscalizadora gera debate sobre legalidade
item.description: President Lula's (PT) government issued a decree assigning new social media regulation functions to a regulatory agency, sparking debate over the measure's legality. Lawyers and constitutional law professors consulted by Folha question whether the Executive can, via decree, grant such authority without explicit legislative authorization.
